title: 02 Days Jaipur Tour Package

days.day_description:
Welcome to Jaipur! The Pink City! Upon your arrival at Jaipur Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. After a refreshing breakfast at the hotel, get ready to explore the magnificent attractions of the Pink City, including:
As evening approaches, immerse yourself in an authentic Rajasthani culture with a delicious dinner at a local resort. Enjoy the vibrant folk music, cultural dance performances, and the delightful rural atmosphere.
Relax and unwind with an overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.

activities.title: City Palace
activities.description: A stunning mixture of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture

activities.title: Amer Fort
activities.description: The royal hilltop fort, best for photo shoot

activities.title: Nahargarh Fort & Palaces
activities.description: Offering panoramic views of the entire Jaipur city

days.day_description: After having your Breakfast, now it is time for departure. A cab will drop you at Jaipur Airport / Railway Station. (The Tour Ends)

title: 03 Days Delhi, Agra & Jaipur Tour Package

days.day_description:
Welcome to Delhi! Our representative will give you a warm welcome at Delhi Airport or railway station. We will start our journey by exploring the stunning attractions of Delhi:
Later we will move to Agra. Upon the time of arrival, we will check in at hotel. Enjoy the comfortable stay at Agra hotel.

After having a delicious breakfast, we will visit most iconic sites of Agra:
Taj Mahal - The symbol of love
Agra Fort – Unique and attractive creation
Itimad-Ud-Daulah– A Historic Place of Worship
Local Markets & Bazaars – Best for spending time and do shopping
In the afternoon, we will head to Jaipur (Pink City). Check in at your hotel upon arrival and enjoy a restful night in Jaipur.

Start your day with a hearty breakfast before we set off to discover the historic pink city of Jaipur:
Hawa Mahal - The famous "Palace of Winds."
City Palace - A fabulous mixture of Rajasthani and Mughal culture.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - A remarkable collection of planetary instruments.
Jal Mahal - The beautiful "Water Palace."
Amer Fort - A majestic fort with stunning views.
Nahargarh Fort - Offering beautiful panoramic views of the city.
After a day full of sightseeing, we will drop you off at the Jaipur railway station or airport for your departure.End of Tour – Safe Travels!

inclusions: Daily breakfast
Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes

Complimentary accommodation for children below 5 years of age

Upon your arrival at the Railway Station/Airport in Delhi, our representative will warmly welcome you. You will then be escorted to your hotel for check-in. Delhi, being India's capital city, is renowned for its tourist attractions, diverse cuisine, and bustling markets. Take the day to explore on your own.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Delhi.

After a hearty breakfast, embark on a tour to explore the iconic attractions of Delhi:
Red Fort - A symbol of India's rich history.
Purana Quila (Old Fort) - Ancient fortress with tales.
Jama Masjid - Magnificent mosque of Delhi.
Qutub Minar - Tower of victory.
India Gate - Memorial honoring soldiers.
Chandni Chowk - Lively market street.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple - Spiritual haven.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Delhi.

Agra is home to the wonderful Taj Mahal, Agra catches attention of visitors with its rich Mughal tradition. Explore grand forts, beautiful gardens, and everlasting architectural wonders.
After breakfast, journey to Agra. Upon arrival and check-in at the hotel, relax before exploring:
Taj Mahal - Timeless symbol of love.
Agra Fort - Mughal architectural gem.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah (Baby Taj) - Elegant marble mausoleum.
Markets & Bazaars - Shopping delights of Agra.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Agra.

After breakfast, depart for Jaipur. Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
Upon arrival and hotel check-in, relax before an evening exploration of Jaipur's modern attractions:
Statue Circle - Modern city landmark.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Celestial insights.
Vidhan Sabha - Seat of legislative assembly.
Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple) - Marble marvel.
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Cultural hub.
Enjoy a delightful Rajasthani dinner with folk music and dance in a village setting.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.

After breakfast, explore the historic treasures of Jaipur's old city:
Hawa Mahal - Palace of winds.
City Palace - Residence of Jaipur's royalty.
Jantar Mantar (Observatory) - Architectural astronomical instruments.
Jal Mahal - Palace amidst the lake.
Amer Fort - Ancient hilltop fortress.
Nahargarh Fort - Guardian fort of Jaipur.
In the evening, witness the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.

days.day_title: Jaipur Day Trip to Pushkar and Ajmer
days.day_description:
After breakfast, take a day trip to Ajmer and Pushkar, both important religious sites. Ajmer: A spiritual hub, Ajmer is home to the revered Ajmer Sharif Dargah. Experience the city's rich religious heritage, bustling markets, and serene Ana Sagar Lake.Pushkar is renowned for its sacred Pushkar Lake and the Brahma Temple, Pushkar is a vibrant pilgrimage site. Enjoy the lively Pushkar Camel Fair and the town's bohemian vibe.
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti in Ajmer - Sacred Sufi shrine.
Brahma Temple in Pushkar - Holy shrine of Lord Brahma, the creator.
Return to Jaipur in the evening and relax at the hotel.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
After breakfast, you will be transferred to Jaipur Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. (The Tour Ends)

Immerse yourself in Jaipur, the Pink City, where royal palaces and busy bazaars represent the vibrant essence of Rajasthan's royal heritage. You will really enjoy your visit here in Jaipur.
Upon your arrival at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport, our representative will warmly greet you. Check-in at the hotel and take some time to relax. In the evening, explore the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Enjoy a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort, accompanied by folk music and cultural dances in a rural village setting.
Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaipur.

activities.title: Birla Auditorium & Planetarium
activities.description: Venue for cultural events and star-gazing.

activities.title: Birla Mandir
activities.description: Marble temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu.

activities.title: Jawahar Kala Kendra
activities.description: Center for art exhibitions and performances.

days.day_description:
After a leisurely breakfast, explore the historic Pink City:
In the evening, witness the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amber Fort, narrating Rajasthan's history through lights and music.
Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaipur.

activities.title: Hawa Mahal
activities.description: The Palace of Winds, offering stunning views.

activities.title: City Palace
activities.description: Blend of Rajput and Mughal architecture.

activities.title: Amber Fort
activities.description: Majestic fort with intricate carvings and ramparts.

days.day_description:
After breakfast, depart for Udaipur, with enroute visits to Ajmer and Pushkar:
Continue your journey to Udaipur and check-in at the hotel. Overnight stay at Udaipur.

Surrender to the charm of Udaipur, the Venice of the East, where shining lakes mirror antique palaces, and every corner whisper tales of romance and valour.
Explore the beautiful Lake City after breakfast:
Overnight stay at the hotel in Udaipur.

activities.title: City Palace
activities.description: Grand royal residence overlooking Lake Pichola.

activities.title: Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal
activities.description: Museum of folk art and culture.

activities.title: Saheliyon ki Bari
activities.description: Garden adorned with fountains and marble pavilions.

activities.title: Fateh Sagar Lake
activities.description: Artificial lake offering serene boat rides.

days.day_description:
Escape to Mount Abu, Rajasthan's only hill station, where cool breezes kiss lush green landscapes dotted with serene lakes and ancient temples.
After breakfast, proceed to Mount Abu and check-in at the hotel. Explore the serene hill station and its attractions:
Overnight stay at the hotel in Mount Abu.

activities.title: Guru Shikhar
activities.description: Highest peak in the Aravalli Range.

days.day_description:
Embark on a journey through Jodhpur, the Blue City, where the mighty Mehrangarh Fort stands sentinel over a sea of azure rooftops, narrating tales of courage and conquest.
After breakfast, drive to Jodhpur. Check-in at the hotel and explore the captivating Blue City:
Overnight stay at the hotel in Jodhpur.

activities.title: Jaswant Thada
activities.description: Marble cenotaph dedicated to Maharaja Jaswant Singh II.

activities.title: Mehrangarh Fort
activities.description: Majestic fort offering panoramic views of the city.

days.day_description:
After breakfast, our representative will drop you off at Jodhpur Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. Your memorable Rajasthan tour concludes here.
This itinerary ensures you experience the rich history, vibrant culture, and natural beauty of Jaipur, Udaipur, Mount Abu, and Jodhpur, offering a perfect blend of heritage and scenic landscapes across Rajasthan.

title: 07 Days Jaipur-Ranthambhore-Udaipur & Jodhpur Tour Package

days.day_description:
Upon arrival at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport, our representative will greet you and assist with checking into your hotel. After settling in, in the evening, explore the modern attractions of Jaipur, known as the Pink City:
Experience a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort, accompanied by folk dance music and cultural performances in a rustic village atmosphere.
Overnight stay in Jaipur.

Explore Jaipur, the Pink City, where ancient palaces and forts echo tales of royalty amidst bustling markets and vibrant culture.
After a hearty breakfast, embark on a tour of Jaipur's historic Pink City:
In the evening, enjoy the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, showcasing Rajasthan's rich history through lights and sound effects.
Overnight stay in Jaipur.

Dive into the wild heart of India at Ranthambhore, where dense jungles and ancient ruins form the backdrop to thrilling tiger safaris and rich biodiversity.
After breakfast, depart for Ranthambhore. Check into your hotel and relax. In the afternoon, explore the natural wonders of Ranthambhore National Park on an exciting jungle safari by canter (open vehicle safari).
Overnight stay in Ranthambhore.

Enjoy breakfast amidst the serene surroundings of Ranthambhore. Visit:
Later, proceed to Udaipur. Check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Udaipur.

Lose yourself in the romantic allure of Udaipur, the City of Lakes, where palaces float on shimmering waters, and history whispers through cobblestone streets.
After breakfast, explore the picturesque Lake City:
Overnight stay in Udaipur.

Discover the majestic Blue City of Jodhpur, where the towering Mehrangarh Fort overlooks a sea of indigo-hued houses, offering a glimpse into Rajasthan's regal past.
After breakfast, drive to Jodhpur, the enchanting Blue City. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and visit its iconic landmarks:
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

After breakfast, you will be transferred to Jodhpur Railway Station or Airport for your departure. Your memorable Rajasthan tour concludes here.

title: 07 Days Jaisalmer-Jodhpur-Mount abu & Udaipur Tour Package

days.day_description:
Golden city welcomes with charm. It will be a memorable tour. You will be received by our representative at Jaisalmer airport/railway station and transferred to the hotel. After some relaxation at the hotel. In the evening, we visit the beautiful attractions of the golden city which includes:
Gadisar Lake - Tranquil oasis amidst desert sands.
Vyas Chhatri - Architectural marvel in golden hues.
War Museum - Honouring valour and sacrifice.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaisalmer.

Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces - Sentinel of the desert realm.
Jain Temples - Intricate marvels of faith.
Patwo ki Haveli - Elegant abode of merchants.
Nathmal Haveli - Architectural splendour in sandstone.
Salim Singh ki Haveli - Legacy of a nobleman.
In the evening, we go for a unique experience of night accommodation in a tent at Sam Sand Dunes desert with cultural programs and a very exciting camel ride, enjoy the beautiful sunset & traditional dinner.
Overnight at Desert Camp.

activities.title: Jaisalmer
activities.description: Where sands whisper ancient tales.After breakfast, we proceed to visit the attractive Monuments of the Golden city like:

days.day_description:
Get ready to explore blue city which is beckons with history.After breakfast, we drove to Jodhpur. Soon after check-in, we visit the amazing places of the Blue city which includes:
Ummaid Bhawan Palace Museum - Legacy of royal grandeur.
Jaswant Thada - Peaceful memorial in marble.
Mehrangarh Fort - Citadel of indomitable spirits.
Overnight stay at Jodhpur hotel.

Delwara Temple - Exquisite craftsmanship in marble.
Vedi Temple - Devotion amidst serene landscapes.
Nakki Lake - Mirror of tranquility and charm.
Sunset Point - Nature's canvas at dusk.
Tod Rock - Mystical boulder with tales.
Guru Shikhar - Peak of spiritual solace.
Achalgarh Mahadev Temple - Ancient shrine in scenic setting.
Brahma Kumari Ashram - Retreat for spiritual rejuvenation.
Overnight stay at Mount Abu hotel.

activities.title: Mount Abu
activities.description: Where tranquil mountains are whispering ancient tales.After breakfast, it’s time to make your way to Mount Abu. Check-in at the hotel. Soon after, we visit the major attractions of Mount Abu:

days.day_description:
Architectural marvels and serene lakes of Udaipur give you long lasting memories. After breakfast, we will move to Udaipur. Before reaching Udaipur, we visit Ranakpur Jain temples, one of the five major pilgrimages of the Jains, well known for their splendid architectural style. Later, we transfer to Udaipur and check in at the hotel.
Overnight stay at Udaipur Hotel.

After breakfast, we drive to explore every nook & corner of the Lake City, including:
City Palace - Regal abode overlooking lakes.
Jagdish Temple - Spiritual oasis amidst opulence.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal - Showcasing folk arts vibrantly.
Pratap Smarak - Tribute to a valiant ruler.
Shilp Gram - Crafts village celebrating creativity.
Bagori ki Haveli - Historic mansion of bygone era.
Saheliyon ki Bari - Garden of royal delights.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.

Now it is the time to leave Lake City.After morning breakfast, it is departure time. You will be dropped at Udaipur Railway Station/Airport. (The Tour Ends)
This itinerary captures the essence of Rajasthan's cultural heritage, history, and natural beauty, ensuring a memorable journey through its iconic cities and landscapes.

title: 08 Days Udaipur-Mount Abu-Jodhpur& Jaisalmer Tour Package

days.day_description:
Udaipur, where royal palaces reflect on peaceful lakes, echoing tales of timeless beauty and charm. Upon arrival at Udaipur Railway Station/Airport, our representative will warmly welcome you and assist you to your hotel. Rest of the day is free for you to relax and unwind.
In the evening, enjoy a serene Boat Ride on Lake Pichola at sunset.

After breakfast, start with a comprehensive tour of Udaipur:
City Palace - Royal heritage unfolds here.
Jagdish Temple - Architectural marvel of Udaipur.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal - Cultural treasures on display.
Pratap Smarak - Tribute to courageous history.
Shilp Gram - Artisan village charm.
Bagore ki Haveli - Echoes of royal life.
Saheliyon ki Bari-Peaceful Garden retreat.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.

Mount Abu, a calm retreat Rajasthani hill, where ancient temples and scenic vistas consists of textile and spiritual comfort.
After breakfast, proceed to Mount Abu. Check in at the hotel and visit:
Delwara Temple - Lovely Jain craftsmanship.
Vedi Temple - Calm spiritual refuge.
Nakki Lake - Picturesque natural beauty.
Sunset Point - Spectacular beautiful views.
Tod Rock - Scenic rock formations.
Guru Shikhar - Highest peak adventure.
Achalgarh Mahadev - Ancient temple fort.
Brahma Kumari Ashram - Spiritual sanctuary.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Mount Abu.

Jodhpur, the 'Blue City', where majestic forts rise from the desert. After breakfast, head to Jodhpur with a stopover at Ranakpur Jain Temples, renowned for their architectural brilliance and religious significance. Continue to Jodhpur and check in at the hotel.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jodhpur.

Begin your beautiful day with a visit to:
Ummaid Bhawan Palace Museum - Luxurious history awaits.
Jaswant Thada - Marble memorial peace.
Mehrangarh Fort - Majestic stronghold of Rajasthan.
Clock Tower & Markets - Vibrant local culture hub.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jodhpur.

Jaisalmer, the 'Golden City', where ancient sandstone fortresses shine under the desert sun, a mirage of history and culture. After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer. Check in at the hotel and freshen up before visiting:
War Museum - Military history insights.
Gadisar Lake - Peaceful oasis charm.
Vyas Chhatri - Architectural marvel viewpoint.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaisalmer.

Explore the highlights of Jaisalmer:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces - Golden city's crown jewel.
Jain Temples - Complex sandstone craftsmanship.
Patwon ki Haveli - Historical merchant mansion.
Salim Singh ki Haveli - Unique architectural refinement.
Nathmal ki Haveli - Fusion of local styles.
Later, enjoy a unique overnight stay in tents at a Desert Camp amidst dunes with cultural programs, camel rides, bonfire, sunset views, and dinner.

After breakfast, check out from the Desert Camp and visit:
Lodhurva - Sign of Ancient charm.
Amar Sagar - Serene oasis peacefulness.
Kuldhara - Haunted village echoes.
You will then be transferred to Jaisalmer Railway Station/Airport for your departure.
(The Tour Ends)

title: 11 Days Jaipur-Ajmer/Pushkar-Kumbhalgarh-Udaipur-Jodhpur & Jaisalmer Tour Package

days.day_description:
Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
Upon arrival at Jaipur Railway station/Airport, our representative will greet you. Check-in at the hotel. Relax and in the evening, explore modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle - Iconic Monument in Jaipur
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Hub of Cultural Events
Vidhan Sabha - Legislative Assembly of Rajasthan
Birla Mandir - Marble Splendor in Jaipur
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Artistic Hub of Jaipur
Enjoy a Rajasthani dinner with folk dance and cultural music at a rural atmosphere resort. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

After breakfast, explore the old Pink City:
Hawa Mahal - Palace of Winds Architectural Marvel
City Palace - Royal Residence of Jaipur
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - Historic Astronomical Instruments
Jal Mahal - Palace in the Middle of the Lake
Amer Fort - Ancient Hill Fort Grandeur
Nahargarh Fort & Places - Scenic Fort with History
In the evening, witness the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amer Fort. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

Pushkar is renowned for its sacred Pushkar Lake and the Brahma Temple, Pushkar is a vibrant pilgrimage site. Enjoy the lively Pushkar Camel Fair and the town's bohemian vibe.
After breakfast, proceed to Ajmer and Pushkar. Check-in at the hotel and visit:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti at Ajmer - Sacred Sufi Shrine in Ajmer
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar - Hindu Pilgrimage Icon
Overnight stay in Pushkar.

activities.title: Ajmer
activities.description: A spiritual hub, Ajmer is home to the revered Ajmer Sharif Dargah. Experience the city's rich religious heritage, bustling markets, and serene Ana Sagar Lake.

days.day_description:
After breakfast, journey towards Udaipur via Kumbhalgarh. Kumbhalgarh is famous for its formidable fort and expansive walls, Kumbhalgarh stands as a testament to Rajasthan's martial legacy. Explore the UNESCO World Heritage site and its intricate architecture.
Kumbhalgarh Fort - Majestic Fortress of Rajasthan
Arrive in Udaipur, check-in at the hotel. Overnight stay in Udaipur.

Udaipur also known as the "City of Lakes," it enchants with its serene waters, grand palaces, and romantic atmosphere. Visit the exquisite City Palace and enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola.
After breakfast, explore the Lake City's highlights:
City Palace - Royal Residence by Lake
Pratap Smarak - Memorial to a Hero
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal - Cultural Museum
Saheliyon ki Bari - Garden of the Maidens
Jagdish Temple - Sacred Hindu Shrine
Bagore ki Haveli - Historic Mansion on Lake
Shilp Gram - Crafts Village
Fateh Sagar Lake - Scenic Water Body
Overnight stay in Udaipur.

Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, Mount Abu offers a refreshing retreat with cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic viewpoints. Visit the famous Dilwara Temples and enjoy the peaceful Nakki Lake.
After breakfast, proceed to Mount Abu:
Delwara Temple - Exquisite Jain Temples
Vedi Temple - Spiritual Oasis
Nakki Lake - Tranquil Waterbody
Sunset Point - Mesmerizing Evening Views
Tod Rock - Historical Landmark
Guru Shikhar - Highest Peak in Aravalli
Achalgarh Mahadev Temple - Ancient Temple
Brahma Kumari Ashram - Spiritual Retreat
Overnight stay in Mount Abu.

days.day_title: Mount Abu to Ranakpur to Jodhpur
days.day_description:
After breakfast, depart for Jodhpur via Ranakpur:
Ranakpur Jain Temples - Architectural Marvels
Arrive in Jodhpur, check-in at the hotel. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

After breakfast, explore the Blue City's attractions. The "Blue City" Jodhpur boasts the majestic fort and a sea of blue houses. Discover its rich history, exciting shopping markets, and scenic views of the Thar Desert.
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum - Opulent Palace Turned Museum
Jaswant Thada - Memorial of White Marble
Mehrangarh Fort - Impregnable Hill Fort

Statue Circle - Symbol of Rajasthan's Proud Heritage

Birla Mandir - Divine Peace Amidst Urban Rush

Later, enjoy a delicious Rajasthani dinner at a resort with pleasant folk music and cultural dances in a village setting. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.

After breakfast, we will explore the old pink city and visit these places:
Hawa Mahal - Wind Palace of Pink City
City Palace - Royal Splendor in Every Corner
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - Ancient Wisdom Meets Astronomical Marvel
Jal Mahal - Palace Floats on Tranquil Waters
Amer Fort - Majestic Fortress of Rich History
Nahargarh Fort & Palace - Panoramic Views, Regal Architecture United
In the evening, enjoy a Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, showcasing the magnificent history of Rajasthan. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.

Pushkar is renowned for its sacred Pushkar Lake and the Brahma Temple, Pushkar is a vibrant pilgrimage site. Enjoy the lively Pushkar Camel Fair and the town's bohemian vibe.
After breakfast, we will head to Pushkar. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel. Then, we will visit Ajmer and Pushkar, famous pilgrimage centers:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti at Ajmer - Spiritual Haven of Peaceful Reflection
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar - Sacred Hub of Divine Presence
Overnight stay at your hotel in Pushkar.

Junagarh Fort - Ancient Stronghold of Rajput Valor

Karni Mata Temple - Holy Sanctuary of Revered Rats
Overnight stay at your hotel in Bikaner.

After breakfast, we will drive to Jaisalmer and check in at your hotel. After freshening up, we will visit the Golden City:
War Museum - Echoes of Valor and Sacrifice
Gadisar Lake - Tranquil Oasis in Desert Sands
Vyas Chhatri - Architectural Serenity Amidst Desert Beauty
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaisalmer.

activities.title: Jaisalmer
activities.description: The "Golden City" Jaisalmer mesmerizes with its yellow sandstone architecture and the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort. Experience desert safaris, ornate havelis, and a glimpse into desert life.

days.day_description:

Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces - Golden Citadel of Desert Majesty
Jain Temples - Sacred Marvels of Intricate Carvings

Salim Singh Ki Haveli - Elegant Residence in Desert Splendor
Nathmal Ki Haveli - Symphony of Sandstone Artistry
Later, experience a night in the desert with cultural programs, a camel ride, bonfire, sunset, and dinner. Overnight stay at the Desert Camp.

The "Blue City" Jodhpur boasts the majestic fort and a sea of blue houses. Discover its rich history, exciting shopping markets, and scenic views of the Thar Desert.
After breakfast, we will check out from the desert camp and move towards Jodhpur. After checking in at your hotel, we will visit the Blue City:
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum - Grandeur Preserved in Royal Legacy
Jaswant Thada - Marble Serenity Amidst History
Mehrangarh Fort - Guardian of Jodhpur's Legacy
Clock Tower & Markets - Pulse of Jodhpur's Vibrant Culture
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jodhpur.

Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, Mount Abu offers a refreshing retreat with cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic viewpoints. Visit the famous Dilwara Temples and enjoy the peaceful Nakki Lake.
After breakfast, we will head to Mount Abu. Check in at your hotel, and then visit the major attractions of Mount Abu:
Delwara Temple - Divine Elegance in Marble
Vedi Temple - Spiritual Haven Amidst Hills
Nakki Lake - Tranquil Mirror of Nature
Sunset Point - Nature's Canvas Unfolding Beauty
Toad Rock - Nature's Art
Guru Shikhar - Peak of Spiritual Solace
Achalgarh Mahadev - Ancient Spiritual Resonance
Brahma Kumari Ashram - Spiritual Retreat in Tranquility
Overnight stay at your hotel in Mount Abu.

After breakfast, we will proceed to Udaipur. On the way, we will visit Ranakpur Jain Temples, known for their splendid architectural style. Later, we will transfer to Udaipur and check in at your hotel. Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.

Udaipur also known as the "City of Lakes," it enchants with its serene waters, grand palaces, and romantic atmosphere. Visit the exquisite City Palace and enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola.
After breakfast, we will explore every nook and corner of the Lake City, including:
City Palace - Palatial Marvel by Lake Pichola
Jagdish Temple - Architectural Gem of Udaipur
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal - Cultural Heritage in Living Art
Pratap Smarak - Heroic Tribute to Maharana Pratap
Shilp Gram - Artisan Village of Crafts
Bagore Ki Haveli - Timeless Heritage on Lake Shore
Saheliyon Ki Bari - Garden of Maidens' Delight
Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.

After breakfast, we will drive to Ranthambhore and check in at your hotel. After some relaxation, we will visit the beautiful Ranthambhore National Park, famous for its wildlife. In the afternoon, enjoy a jungle safari by canter. Overnight stay at your hotel in Ranthambhore.
After breakfast, we will depart for Jaipur. You will be dropped off at the Jaipur Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here. Safe travels!

Agra, Home to the Taj Mahal, Agra resonates with Mughal luxury, showcasing architectural marvels and a timeless symbol of love.
After breakfast, proceed to Agra. Check-in at the hotel and relax. Later, visit:
Overnight stay in Agra.

Jaipur, The Pink City of Rajasthan, renowned for its royal heritage, majestic forts, vibrant bazaars, and colourful cultural traditions. After breakfast, drive to Jaipur. Check-in at the hotel. In the evening, visit Jaipur's modern attractions:
Enjoy a Rajasthani dinner at a resort with folk dance and music.

After breakfast, explore Jaipur's historic attractions:
In the evening, enjoy the Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.

Ajmer, A spiritual retreat known for the revered Dargah Sharif, mixing religious significance with historical charm and a peaceful environment.
Pushkar, Famous for its sacred Brahma Temple and vibrant Pushkar Fair, this holy town emits spiritual serenity and cultural vibrancy.
After breakfast, proceed to Udaipur via Ajmer and Pushkar. Visit:
Later, continue to Udaipur and check-in at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Udaipur.

activities.title: Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti at Ajmer

days.day_description:
Udaipur, The City of Lakes captivates with its regal palaces, shimmering lakes, lavish gardens, and romantic ambiance, epitomizing Rajasthan's charm.
After breakfast, explore the charming attractions of Udaipur:
Overnight stay in Udaipur.

Mount Abu, Rajasthan's only hill station, offers cool climate, scenic landscapes, and spiritual retreats amidst the Aravalli Range. After breakfast, travel to Mount Abu. Check-in at the hotel. Enjoy leisure time.

After breakfast, visit the major attractions of Mount Abu:
Overnight stay in Mount Abu.

activities.title: Delwara Temple
activities.description: Lovely marble architecture in Mount Abu.

days.day_description:
Jodhpur, The Blue City boasts towering forts, luxurious residences, busy markets, and a rich textile of Rajputana culture and hospitality. After breakfast, proceed to Jodhpur via Ranakpur. Visit the renowned Jain temples of Ranakpur. Continue to Jodhpur and check-in at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

After breakfast, explore the attractions of Jodhpur:
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

Jaisalmer, The Golden City of India, where sand dunes meet skilled carved havelis and the majestic Jaisalmer Fort, raising tales of courage and royalty.
After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer. Check-in at the hotel. Visit:
Later, experience a night in the desert with cultural programs, camel ride, bonfire, and dinner at a desert camp.

Known for Junagarh Fort, camel safaris, and Karni Mata Temple, Bikaner blends desert charm with architectural brilliance and cultural richness.
After breakfast, proceed to Bikaner. Visit:
Overnight stay in Bikaner.
After breakfast, drive to Jaipur for departure. You will be dropped at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport. The tour concludes here.
